orchestrator.description: Manages build phases, reviews between iterations, passes quality gates

developer.description: Builds and iterates on the project

steps.label: Scaffold
steps.description: Set up project structure, dependencies, and base files. Read context/status.md for mission state. First commit. Update context/status.md when done.

steps.label: Build
steps.description: Implement core functionality from the brief. Read context/status.md for current state. Tests for key behavior. Commit frequently. Update context/status.md when done.

steps.label: Ship
steps.description: Polish, final fixes, deployment config. Read context/status.md for outstanding items. Final commit. Update context/status.md with final state.
